item.title: Uniswap Launches Pools for Robinhood Chain Token Listings
item.summary: Uniswap Labs has expanded its decentralized finance ecosystem by introducing Pools, a dedicated token launchpad for Robinhood Chain, the Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain launched by Robinhood in July 2026. The new platform enables users to create, launch, bid on, and trade tokens directly while incorporating decentralized finance features designed to improve liquidity management and reduce […] The post Uniswap Launches Pools for Robinhood Chain Token Listings appeared first on CoinTrust .
